sources.title: Public Holidays Act, 1964 (Chapter 272), as at 31 December 1996 (Laws.Africa for ZambiaLII, from the Ministry of Legal Affairs' revised edition)
sources.said: 2. (1) The days mentioned in the Schedule shall be observed throughout Zambia as public holidays. (2) Whenever any of the days mentioned in the Schedule falls on a Sunday, the following Monday shall be observed as a public holiday. 3. The Minister shall have power, by statutory notice, from time to time to declare that any day or days shall be observed in Zambia as public holidays in addition to the days mentioned in the Schedule ... Schedule: (a) New Year's Day (b) Youth Day (12th March) (c) Good Friday (d) Holy Saturday (e) Lbour Day (1st May) (f) African Freedom Day (25th May) (g) Heroes Day (First Monday in July) (h) Unity Day (Tuesday following Heroes Day) (i) Farmers Day (First Monday in August) (j) Independence Day (24th October) (k) Christmas Day [As amended by Act No. 23 of 1987]

sources.said: 2. It is hereby declared that the 8th of March in every year, commencing with 8th March, 2008, shall be observed as a public holiday in commemoration of the International Women's day.

sources.title: National Assembly of Zambia, Report of the Committee on Governance, Housing and Chiefs' Affairs on the Public Holidays (Amendment) Bill, N.A.B. No. 76 of 2026

sources.title: Public Holidays Act (Chapter 174), as at 31 December 2023 (revised and consolidated by the Law Reform Commission of Uganda; Laws.Africa for ULII)
sources.said: 2. (1) The days specified in Schedule 2 to this Act are declared to be public holidays, which, subject to this Act, shall in every year be kept and observed as public holidays throughout Uganda. (2) In addition ... the President may declare any other day to be a public holiday, and may limit the observation of any such public holiday to any area or place in Uganda. ... Schedule 2: Archbishop Janan Luwum Day - 16th February; Birth of Prophet Muhammed Day; Boxing Day - 26th December; Christmas Day - 25th December; Easter Monday; Good Friday; Idd Adhua; Idd el-Fitr Day; Idd-ul-Zuho Day; Independence Day - 9th October; Labour Day - 1st May; Martyrs’ Day - 3rd June; National Heroes Day - 9th June; New Year’s Day - 1st January; Women’s Day - 8th March. (Idd Adhua and Idd-ul-Zuho are both names of the feast of sacrifice, kept once.)

sources.title: Décret n° 100/150 du 07 juin 2021 portant modification du décret n° 100/182 du 17 juillet 2006 fixant la liste et le régime des jours fériés (Présidence de la République du Burundi)
sources.said: Article 1 : La liste des jours fériés, chômés et payés est arrêtée comme suit : 1. le 1er janvier : Premier Jour du nouvel an ; 2. le 05 février : Fête de l'Unité et de la Réconciliation Nationales ; 3. le 06 avril : Commémoration de l'Assassinat du Président Cyprien NTARYAMIRA ; 4. le jour de l'Ascension ; 5. le 1er mai : Fête Internationale du Travail ; 6. le 08 juin : Journée Nationale du Patriotisme et Commémoration de la Mort du Président Pierre NKURUNZIZA ; 7. le 1er juillet : Anniversaire de l'Indépendance ; 8. le 15 août : Assomption ; 9. le 13 octobre : Commémoration de l'Assassinat du Héros National, le Prince Louis RWAGASORE ; 10. le 21 octobre : Commémoration de l'Assassinat du Président Melchior NDADAYE ; 11. le 1er novembre : la Toussaint ; 12. le 25 décembre : Noël ; 13. l'Aid-El-Fithr ; 14. l'Aid-El-Hadj. ... Article 3 : Outre les jours fériés et chômés figurant à la liste de l'article premier, tout autre jour pourra, par décret, être déclaré férié. Article 4 : Lorsqu'il paraîtra inopportun qu'un jour férié prévu à la liste de l'article premier soit observé parce qu'il coïncide avec un dimanche, il sera reporté au jour ouvrable suivant, qui en conséquence, sera considéré comme férié et observé comme tel.

sources.title: Décret N°25-147/PR du 19 décembre 2025 fixant la liste des jours fériés, chômés et payés en Union des Comores (Munganyo, the Union's register of decrees, https://munganyo.km/decrees/526)
sources.said: ARTICLE 1er : Les jours fériés, chômés, et payés sur l'ensemble du territoire de l'Union des Comores sont classés en deux (2) catégories, comme suit : 1. Jours fériés à caractère religieux : Le premier jour de l'An musulman ; Le jour de la Naissance du prophète Muhammad ; Les trois (3) jours suivant le 29 du mois de Ramadan ; Le jour et le lendemain de l'Ide El Kabir. 2. Jours fériés à caractère civil : Le 1er janvier, jour de l'An ; Le 17 février, jour de la Réconciliation nationale ; Le 1er mai, Fête internationale du Travail ; Le 6 juillet, Fête de l'Indépendance ; Le 7 juillet, lendemain de la Fête d'Indépendance ; Le 12 novembre, jour de l'Admission des Comores aux Nations unies. ... ARTICLE 3 : Un jour ouvrable intercalé entre deux (2) jours fériés, entre un jour férié et un samedi, ou entre un dimanche et un jour férié, peut être déclaré chômé et payé. ARTICLE 4 : Tout jour, autre que ceux mentionnés à l'article 1er du présent décret, ne peut être déclaré férié, chômé et payé qu'en vertu d'un décret spécifique pris à cet effet. ARTICLE 5 : Le décret N°06-192/PR du 11 novembre 2006, le décret N°03-066/PR du 14 juin 2003, le décret N°99-168/CE du 11 novembre 1999 et le décret N°96-227/PR du 11 novembre 1996 sont abrogés.

sources.title: Présidence de l'Union des Comores (Beit-Salam), Ramadan 1447 (20 February 2026)
sources.said: La Mosquée du Palais du Peuple a accueilli, jeudi 19 février, la cérémonie officielle marquant l'ouverture de la darse du premier jour du mois sacré de Ramadan 1447 de l'Hégire.

sources.title: Présidence de l'Union des Comores (Beit-Salam), Aïd El-Fitr 1447 : le Président de la République appelle à l'unité (21 March 2026)
sources.said: Publié le 21 Mars 2026. À l'occasion de l'Aïd El-Fitr, son Excellence le Président AZALI Assoumani a adressé ses vœux aux Comoriens, saluant un mois de Ramadan marqué par la foi, le partage et la solidarité. (Ramadan's first day 19 February makes its 29th 19 March; the three days following are 20, 21 and 22 March, and the Aïd, 1 Shawwal, is 21 March.)

sources.title: Federal Register of Legislation, Employment Act 1988 (NI), Compilation No. 8 (20 September 2022), section 9
sources.said: 9 Public holidays Each of the following days in a year is to be observed as a public holiday: (a) New Year’s Day—1 January and, if that day is a Saturday or Sunday, the next Monday; (b) Australia Day—26 January, or, if that day is a Saturday or Sunday, the next Monday; (c) Foundation Day—6 March and, if that day is a Sunday, the next Monday; (d) Good Friday; (e) Easter Monday; (f) Anzac Day—25 April; (g) Bounty Day—8 June and, if that day is a Saturday or Sunday, the next Monday; (h) Sovereign’s Birthday—the first Monday after the second Saturday in June or, if that Monday is observed as Bounty Day under paragraph (g), the next Monday; (i) Show Day—the second Monday in October; (j) Thanksgiving—the last Wednesday in November; (k) Christmas Day—25 December and, if that day is a Saturday or Sunday, 27 December; (l) Boxing Day—26 December and, if that day is a Saturday or Sunday, 28 December.

sources.title: Viceministerio de Turismo, Calendario de feriados nacionales 2025-2030 (published 1 September 2025; the copy Expreso hosts, turismo.gob.ec not answering from here)
sources.said: 2026: Año Nuevo: Jueves 01 de enero. Carnaval: Lunes 16 y martes 17 de febrero. Viernes Santo: Viernes 03 de abril. Día del Trabajo: Viernes 01 de mayo. Batalla del Pichincha: Domingo 24 de mayo que se traslada al lunes 25 de mayo. Primer Grito de la Independencia: Lunes 10 de agosto. Independencia de Guayaquil: Viernes 09 de octubre. Día de los difuntos e Independencia de Cuenca: Lunes 02 de noviembre y martes 03 de noviembre. Navidad: Viernes 25 de diciembre. 2027: ... Día del Trabajo: Sábado 01 de mayo que se traslada al viernes 30 de abril. Batalla del Pichincha: Lunes 24 de mayo. Primer Grito de la Independencia: Martes 10 de agosto que se traslada al lunes 09 de agosto. Independencia de Guayaquil: Sábado 09 de octubre que se traslada al viernes 08 de octubre. Día de los difuntos e Independencia de Cuenca: Martes 02 de noviembre y miércoles 03 de noviembre que se traslada al lunes 01 de noviembre, siendo el descanso obligatorio los días 01 y 02 de noviembre. Navidad: Sábado 25 de diciembre. 2028: ... Batalla del Pichincha: Miércoles 24 mayo que se traslada al viernes 26 de mayo. Primer Grito: Jueves 10 de agosto que se traslada al viernes 11 de agosto. Guayaquil: Lunes 09 de octubre. Difuntos y Cuenca: Jueves 02 de noviembre y viernes 03 de noviembre. 2029: ... Día del Trabajo: Martes 01 de mayo que se traslada al lunes 30 de abril. Batalla del Pichincha: Jueves 24 de mayo que se traslada al viernes 25 de mayo. Primer Grito: Viernes 10 de agosto. Guayaquil: Martes 09 de octubre que se traslada al lunes 08 de octubre. Difuntos y Cuenca: Viernes 02 de noviembre y sábado 03 de noviembre que se traslada al jueves 01 de noviembre, siendo el descanso obligatorio los días 01 y 02 de noviembre. 2030: ... Día del Trabajo: Miércoles 01 de mayo que se traslada al viernes 03 de mayo. ... Primer Grito: Sábado 10 de agosto que se traslada al viernes 09 de agosto. Guayaquil: Miércoles 09 de octubre que se traslada al viernes 11 de octubre. Sábado 02 de noviembre que se traslada al viernes 01 de noviembre y domingo 03 de noviembre que se traslada al lunes 04 de noviembre. (Its 2030 Pichincha line, 'Jueves 24 de mayo que se traslada al viernes 25', repeats 2029's: 24 May 2030 is a Friday.) El descanso obligatorio de los días 01 de enero, 25 de diciembre y martes de carnaval no se trasladan, de acuerdo a la Disposición General Cuarta de la Ley Orgánica del Servicio Público, artículo 65 del Código del Trabajo y la Disposición General Primera de la Ley Orgánica Reformatoria a la Ley Orgánica del Servicio Público y al Código del Trabajo publicada en el Registro Oficial Suplemento No. 906 de 20 de Diciembre de 2016.

sources.said: رأس السنة الميلادية 1 كانون الثاني؛ رأس السنة الهجرية 1 محرم؛ عيد الميلاد عند الطوائف الارمنية الارثوذكسية 6 كانون الثاني؛ عيد مار مارون 9 شباط؛ ذكرى عاشوراء 10 محرم؛ ذكرى المولد النبوي 12 ربيع الاول؛ عيد بشارة السيدة مريم العذراء 25 آذار؛ الجمعة العظيمة عند الطوائف الكاثوليكية؛ الجمعة العظيمة عند الطوائف الارثوذكسية (في حال وقوع هذين العيدين في يوم واحد يكون الاقفال يوم الجمعة ويوم السبت الذي يليه)؛ عيد العمل أول أيار (في حال وقوع هذا العيد يوم احد او يوم عطلة: تعطل مؤسسات القطاع الخاص في اليوم التالي ...)؛ عيد انتقال السيدة العذراء 15 آب؛ عيد الفطر 1 و2 شوال؛ عيد الاستقلال 22 تشرين الثاني؛ عيد الأضحى 10 و11 ذي الحجة؛ عيد الميلاد 25 كانون الاول. اذا صادف وقوع العيد او المناسبة يوم احد او يوم عطلة، لا يستعاض عنه بيوم آخر مع مراعاة احكام عيد العمل والجمعة العظيمة.

entries.sought: Every country's price level for what households buy, in its own currency against the US dollar, measured to one standard across countries and as recent as published

sources.title: World Bank, World Development Indicators: PPP conversion factor, households and NPISHs Final consumption expenditure (LCU per international $)
sources.said: lastupdated 2026-10-08; 532 rows (266 economies and aggregates, 2024 and 2025). United States 2025: 1. Bulgaria 2025: 0.414616944167498. Japan 2025: 103.33658. Afghanistan, The Gambia, Equatorial Guinea and Qatar have a value for 2024 and none for 2025.

sources.title: World Bank, the indicator's definition
sources.said: The purchasing power parity (PPP) conversion factor is a currency conversion factor and a spatial price deflator. They convert different currencies to a common currency and, in the process of conversion, equalize their purchasing power by eliminating the differences in price levels between countries ... This conversion factor is for households and NPISHs Final consumption expenditure and the base currency is the US dollar. sources.title: World Bank Data Help Desk, How do you extrapolate the PPP conversion factors estimated by the ICP?
sources.said: The International Comparison Program (ICP) provides PPP conversion factors for the three most recent ICP benchmark years (2011, 2017 and 2021) and years in between the benchmarks (2012-2016 and 2018-2020). For years before 2011 and after 2021, PPPs provided by the ICP are extrapolated to create a time series from 1990 to the latest year available. The method used is to apply the difference between the rate of inflation observed in the country over each period from 2011 (for years before 2011) and 2021 (for years after 2021) compared with inflation in the United States over the same period to the benchmark PPP estimates. ... Extrapolation for private consumption uses the change in the consumer price index (CPI). For example, let's say Senegal's CPI in 2022 divided by its CPI in 2021 is 1.096 ... and the ratio for the US over the same period is 1.081 ... We can take Senegal's private consumption PPP conversion factor in 2021, which was 226.6, and multiply it by 1.096/1.081 to get a 2022 conversion factor estimate of 229.7.

sources.said: Паспорт громадянина України для виїзду за кордон оформлюється дітям від народження строком на 4 роки, громадянам віком від 16 років - строком на 10 років. ... При оформленні цього документу у консульських установах України за кордоном сплачується консульський збір. Оплачується адміністративний збір, який розраховується як сума вартості адміністративної послуги та вартості бланку. У разі оформлення протягом 20 робочих днів сума адміністративного збору складає 1147 грн., у тому числі: вартість адміністративної послуги - 352 грн. вартість бланка - 795 грн. У разі термінового (протягом 7 робочих днів) оформлення,сума адміністративного збору складає 1787 грн., у тому числі: вартість адміністративної послуги - 992 грн. вартість бланка - 795 грн. У разі термінового (протягом 3 робочих днів у випадках, визначених законодавством) оформлення, сума адміністративного збору складає 1787 грн.

entries.sought: Haiti's passport fees abroad by age, from Caribbean National Weekly's report of the foreign ministry's circular

sources.title: Caribbean National Weekly, Haiti sets new passport fees for citizens applying abroad (7 October 2026)
sources.said: Haiti has set new fees for citizens applying for passports at Haitian diplomatic missions and consular posts abroad, while banning additional charges and expedited processing services. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Religious Affairs announced the new measures in a circular dated Oct. 1, with the changes taking effect Oct. 5. Under the new fee structure, passport applications will cost US$150 for adults and US$125 for minors. The ministry said any additional fees charged for passport applications are illegal and prohibited. It also ordered Haitian diplomatic missions and consular posts to stop offering emergency and extreme-emergency passport services.

entries.sought: Sudan's passport fees by age, from Dabanga's report of 3 September 2023

sources.title: Dabanga, Sudan passport fees hike 'blackmail' (3 September 2023)
sources.said: The increase in Sudanese passport issuance fees, now set at SDG150,000 for adults and SDG75,000 for children, has been widely criticised by a significant portion of the population. Sudan’s Ministry of Interior Affairs announced the resumption of passport issuance and the restoration of civil registry and traffic data in nine states on Wednesday. ... In response, Chairman of the Sovereignty Council and Commander-in-Chief of the army Lt Gen Abdelfattah El Burhan directed the police to review the Sudanese passport fees, considering the “circumstances of citizens”.

sources.title: Federal Register of Legislation, Australian Citizenship Act 2007, Compilation No. 37 (compilation date 4 June 2026), ss. 3, 11 and 12

entries.sought: Belarus's national identity card: its name, fees by age and route, and validity, from the issuing authority

sources.title: Zerkalo, on ID cards and biometric passports in Belarus from 1 September 2021 (31 August 2021)
sources.said: За картой нужно обращаться в подразделение по гражданству и миграции по месту регистрации. Гражданам, находящимся за пределами страны, нужно идти в ближайшее диппредставительство или консульство Беларуси. ID-карта будет готова через 15 рабочих дней после того, как человек подал заявление. Если процедура проходит в ускоренном порядке, это займет десять рабочих дней, в срочном — пять. ... детям до 14 лет платить за ID-карту не нужно. Пенсионерам, инвалидам I и II группы она обойдется в 1 базовую (сейчас это 29 рублей), для остальных — в 1,5 базовой (43,5 рубля). ... Срок действия идентификационной карты — 10 лет. Для тех, кому 14 еще не исполнилось, — 5 лет.

entries.sought: Andorra's citizenship: the years of residence its ordinary naturalisation asks, whether other citizenships must be given up, and whether its citizens lose it on taking another

sources.title: VilaWeb, Andorra refusa de reduir els anys de residència per accedir a la nacionalitat i reforça els requisits lingüístics (7 May 2026)
sources.said: El Consell General ha aprovat la reforma de la llei de la nacionalitat ... La reforma manté els vint anys de residència necessaris per a obtenir la nacionalitat andorrana ... els vint anys de residència exigits ja no hauran de ser consecutius, sinó que es podran acumular en períodes interromputs. També es flexibilitzen alguns requisits d’escolarització i s’amplien terminis relacionats amb la renúncia a la nacionalitat d’origen.

sources.title: Consell General, Llei qualificada de la nacionalitat (text as published by the Consell General), article 15
sources.said: Article 15 Qualsevol persona de nacionalitat andorrana perd aquesta nacionalitat, si adquireix una nacionalitat estrangera, des de la data d’aquesta adquisició.

sources.title: Govern d'Andorra, Ministeri de Justícia i Interior, La nacionalitat andorrana d'origen
sources.said: Es andorrà l’infant nascut al Principat d’Andorra, si almenys un dels pares és andorrà. ... És andorrà l’infant nascut a l’estranger si compleix alguna d’aquestes condicions: a) Almenys un dels pares és andorrà i nascut al Principat d’Andorra. b) Almenys un dels pares és andorrà i, al seu torn, fill d’una persona de nacionalitat andorrana nascuda al Principat d’Andorra. c) Almenys un dels pares és andorrà i, al seu torn, fill d’una persona de nacionalitat andorrana que hagi residit al Principat d’Andorra durant, com a mínim deu anys. ... Es andorrà l’infant nascut al Principat d’Andorra, si almenys un dels pares és nascut al Principat d’Andorra, a condició que el progenitor o els progenitors sota l’autoritat del qual o dels quals està legalment sotmès tinguin la seva residència principal i permanent al Principat d’Andorra a la data del naixement de l’infant i l’hagin tingut durant l’any anterior al naixement. ... És andorrà l’infant nascut al Principat d’Andorra de pare i mare estrangers si almenys un dels seus progenitors, sota l’autoritat del qual o dels quals està legalment sotmès, té la residència principal i permanent al Principat d’Andorra a la data de naixement de l’infant i l’hagi tinguda durant els darrers deu anys que han precedit aquest naixement. Si l’esmentat període de deu anys no s’ha complert el dia del naixement de l’infant, la nacionalitat andorrana se li atribueix a títol provisional.

Minister is explicitly allowed to waive certain requirements. ... n.a. ... n.a. ... No provision ... Generational transmission restriction: conditional on birthplace/place of residence /mode under which parent acquired citizenship ... Person is born abroad to a citizen who was born in Antigua and Barbuda, or to a citizen who is in the service of the government, or to a deceased parent who held Antigua and Barbuda citizenship. ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born in Antigua and Barbuda unless the child is born to a foreign diplomat and neither parent is a citizen, or one of the parents is an enemy alien and the child is born in a place then under occupation by the enemy. ... No provision

sources.said: La République reconnaît, au sein du peuple français, les populations d'outre-mer, dans un idéal commun de liberté, d'égalité et de fraternité. La Guadeloupe, la Guyane, la Martinique, La Réunion, Mayotte, Saint Barthélemy, Saint-Martin, Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, les îles Wallis et Futuna et la Polynésie française sont régis par l'article 73 pour les départements et les régions d'outre-mer et pour les collectivités territoriales créées en application du dernier alinéa de l'article 73, et par l'article 74 pour les autres collectivités. sources.title: Conseil constitutionnel, Texte intégral de la Constitution du 4 octobre 1958 en vigueur, article 72-3
sources.said: La République reconnaît, au sein du peuple français, les populations d'outre-mer, dans un idéal commun de liberté, d'égalité et de fraternité. La Guadeloupe, la Guyane, la Martinique, La Réunion, Mayotte, Saint Barthélemy, Saint-Martin, Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, les îles Wallis et Futuna et la Polynésie française sont régis par l'article 73 pour les départements et les régions d'outre-mer et pour les collectivités territoriales créées en application du dernier alinéa de l'article 73, et par l'article 74 pour les autres collectivités. Le statut de la Nouvelle-Calédonie est régi par le titre XIII. La loi détermine le régime législatif et l'organisation particulière des Terres australes et antarctiques françaises et de Clipperton.

sources.title: New to Denmark (SIRI), Exemption from the requirement of a work permit
sources.said: As a rule, a foreign national, who will be working in Denmark, must have a work permit. However, artists, musicians, performers, etc. and associated staff can be exempted from the requirement of a work permit, if they are of importance for a significant artistic event. The artist, musician, performer etc. must, as a rule, be the focal point or main attraction of the event, or at least be of major significance for the artistic event. ... The event must have a short-term character, normally with a duration of less than 14 days.

entries.sought: The credit records of Djibouti: the bureau that keeps them, when a late payment is reported, and how long it stays

sources.title: Banque Centrale de Djibouti, Instruction n° 2018-01 sur la Centrale des Risques de la Banque Centrale de Djibouti (scanned; read by eye)
sources.said: Les déclarations sont effectuées selon une périodicité mensuelle. Les données déclarées sont arrêtées au dernier jour ouvrable de chaque mois et doivent parvenir à la Banque Centrale, sur tout support de transmission électronique tel que prévu par la circulaire n°01/BCD/2012 sur la transmission des états périodiques, au plus tard le dix (10) du mois suivant celui de l'arrêté des situations comptables. ... La Banque Centrale de Djibouti met à la disposition des établissements participants des rapports de crédits ou de solvabilité contenant les montants des concours enregistrés au nom de chaque bénéficiaire ayant fait l'objet d'une déclaration ainsi que d'autres informations complémentaires, notamment l'existence ou non d'incidents de remboursement durant les deux dernières années. ... Les informations collectées sur le crédit ainsi que toutes les données et documents qu'elles ont servi à produire doivent être conservés sous forme nominative pendant une durée de cinq (5) ans par la Centrale des risques, à compter de leur date de mise à disposition par les établissements déclarants. ... Les informations négatives relatives aux clients des établissements participants ne peuvent être retracées dans les rapports de solvabilité les concernant au terme du délai de conservation des données.

sources.title: Loi n°119/AN/15/7ème L portant création d’un système d’information sur le crédit, promulgated 16 July 2016 (Banque Centrale de Djibouti copy; scanned; read by eye)
sources.said: Le système d'information sur le crédit conserve sous forme nominative dans ses bases de données, les informations relatives aux crédits des emprunteurs pour une durée qui ne peut excéder 7 ans. Au-delà de cette durée, les informations ne peuvent être conservées que sous forme anonyme. ... La Banque Centrale détermine les durées maximales de restitution des données, ou catégories de données, qui apparaissent sur les rapports de crédit.

As informações registadas no SCRC serão conservadas em suporte informático por um período de cinco anos, após o qual deverão ser eliminadas. ... Os créditos abatidos e não recebidos devem ser informados no prazo de cinco anos, contados da data do vencimento do contrato ou operação, devendo o registo ser retirado do sistema depois de decorrido esse prazo. ... Os dados de clientes cujo montante de responsabilidades por crédito e garantias não exceda a Dbs. 4.000.000 (quatro milhões de dobras)

sources.title: Central Bank of Nigeria, Revised Standards on Nigeria Uniform Bank Account Number (NUBAN) for Banks and Other Financial Institutions (2019)
sources.said: The NUBAN format shall consist of 16 digits with the following structure: ABCDEFGHIJKLMNO-P where ... ABCDEF is the 3-digit Financial Institution code assigned by the CBN, with 3 leading zeros ... Step 1: Calculate A*3+B*7+C*3+D*3+E*7+F*3+G*3+H*7+I*3+J*3+K*7+L*3+M*3+N*7+O*3 Step 2: Calculate Modulo 10 of your result i.e. the remainder after dividing by 10 Step 3: Subtract your result from 10 to get the Check Digit Step 4: If your result is 10, then use 0 as your check digit ... Therefore, the NUBAN code for this illustration is 0000014579 ... The NUBAN account number advised to a customer shall be 10 digits

sources.said: الرقم الوطني هو رقم وحيد غير مكرر لكل مواطن يتكون من 12 خانة (اثنتي عشرة خانة). ... الخانة رقم (1) (الخانة الأولى) لتحديد (ذكر أو أنثى) بحيث يكون الرقم واحد (1) يدل على الذكر والرقم اثنين (2) يدل على الأنثى. ... الخانة رقم 12 (الخانة الثانية عشرة) تستخدم لفحص الرقم الوطني. ... يُمنح الرقم الوطني منذ الولادة بناء على بيانات الشخص في السجل المدني بمصلحة الأحوال المدنية ... وقف المرتب أو المكافأة أو الاستحقاق المالي لأي مواطن ليبي في حال عدم تقديمه للرقم الوطني المخصص له

sources.title: Law No. (8) of 2014 on the national ID number (DCAF's English translation)
sources.said: The national number shall be one unique number for each citizen made up of twelve (12) digits. ... The second, third, fourth, and fifth digits (digits 2, 3, 4, and 5) shall specify the citizen’s year of birth. ... Digits 6 to 11 shall specify the citizen’s number within the year of birth according to the category of male or female identified in the first digit (digit 1). ... National ID numbers shall be granted at birth, based on an individual’s data in the Civil Registry at the Civil Status Authority

sources.said: The TIN comprises of a 9 to 13 digit numeric code where the first 9 digits is the TIN proper and the last 4 digits is the branch code {in case of business entities). ... Only one TIN shall be assigned to the taxpayer. ... (A) Employees: Within ten (10) days from date of employment ... This applies to individuals who are registering with the BIR for the first time by reason of employment. ... Minors who are earning and who are under the circumstances prescribed under Executive Order No. 98 shall be supplied with TIN.

sources.title: BIR Revenue Memorandum Circular No. 58-91, Adoption of a New Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) (8 July 1991), Supreme Court E-Library
sources.said: the new, unique TIN will consist of 9-digit numeric code in contrast to TAN's alphanumeric code. The first digit will identify the type of taxpayer. The digit zero ("0") will signify a corporation and digits "1" to "9" will denote individual taxpayers. The succeeding seven (7) digits will be sequential and the 9th digit will be a check digit.

sources.said: b) leje qëndrimi ose leje unike e tipit “B”, e ripërtëritshme, e cila lëshohet me afat të përcaktuar ... I huaji, i pajisur me vizë të tipit “D”, si dhe i huaji i cili nuk ka nevojë për vizë me motiv qëndrimi bëjnë kërkesë on-line për leje qëndrimi. ... I huaji brenda 30 ditëve pas hyrjes në territorin e Republikës së Shqipërisë dhe brenda afatit të qëndrimit të ligjshëm në territor për të huajt që hyjnë pa vizë bën kërkesë për lëshimin e lejes së përkohshme të qëndrimit dhe brenda 60 ditëve përpara përfundimit të afatit të lejes ekzistuese të qëndrimit bën kërkesë për ripërtëritjen e saj ... Shqyrtimi i kërkesës dhe lëshimi i lejes unike të qëndrimit kur plotësohen kriteret e kërkuara nga legjislacioni në fuqi bëhen brenda 4 javësh nga dita e aplikimit. ... Leja unike si punëmarrës jepet për kohëzgjatjen e kontratës/ofertës së punës, përveç rasteve kur parashikohet ndryshe në këtë ligj. ... i huaji kryen punë tjetër nga ajo për të cilën është lëshuar leja unike, me përjashtim të të huajve, të cilët kanë një leje të përhershme qëndrimi; ... i huaji ndërpret kontratën e punës për arsye të ndryshme dhe largohet nga vendi i punës për të cilin ka marrë lejen. ... entries.sought: How someone from abroad can come to live in Bonaire, Saint Eustatius and Saba: each residence route's fee, time, term and what it allows

sources.title: Rijksdienst Caribisch Nederland, Verblijfsaanvraag andere nationaliteiten
sources.said: Vreemdelingen die op Bonaire, Sint Eustatius of Saba willen werken óf op een van de eilanden langer dan drie maanden willen verblijven, hebben een verblijfsvergunning nodig. ... Dan kunt u Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba direct inreizen. Zodra u op de eilanden bent, dient u een ... Deze verblijfsvergunning is voor een bepaalde tijd (meestal één jaar) geldig. Vijf jaar lang dient u deze tijdelijke verblijfsvergunning te verlengen . Als u vijf jaar of langer aaneengesloten verblijf heeft gehad binnen Caribisch Nederland, kunt u onder bepaalde voorwaarden een verblijfsvergunning voor onbepaalde tijd aanvragen. ... dan moet u vóór inreis een machtiging tot voorlopig verblijf (MVV) aanvragen.

sources.title: Rijksdienst Caribisch Nederland, Verblijfsaanvraag Nederlanders
sources.said: Bent u Europees Nederlander of bent u Nederlander uit Curaçao, Sint Maarten en Aruba? ... Dan heeft u vrije toegang tot Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba tot maximaal 180 dagen per 365 dagen. ... Wilt u langer dan 180 dagen toeristisch verblijven of langer dan 90 dagen verblijven waarbij u ook (deels) werkt/stageloopt? Dan moet u een Verklaring van Rechtswege aanvragen. ... Voor het aanvragen van een Verklaring van Rechtswege kunt u een afspraak maken via de telefoon of e-mail.

entries.sought: The Democratic Republic of the Congo's category B driving licence (permis de conduire): the age it is issued from, its fee and term, from the Ministry of Transport or the Code de la route and the order of 2 August 2023.

attempts.tried: https://www.mtpt.gov.cd/, https://www.transports.gouv.cd/ (its WordPress posts and pages searched for "permis"), https://www.primature.gouv.cd/
attempts.result: mtpt.gov.cd timed out; transports.gouv.cd answers but its posts have nothing on the licence and its pages only "Structures sous tutelles"; the Prime Minister's site has no licence page.

attempts.tried: https://www.leganet.cd/; https://www.journalofficiel.cd/ (its search routes /actes?search=, /recherche?q=, /search?q= for "permis de conduire")
attempts.result: leganet.cd timed out; the Journal officiel's site answers but its search routes give 404 or 502 to a plain request.

attempts.tried: "RDC permis de conduire biométrique coût 2026 durée de validité âge minimum catégorie B arrêté ministère des transports"
attempts.result: Mostly France's rules; for the DRC, press on the biometric licence (bankable.africa, allafrica, infos.cd); no ministry page or the order's text.

attempts.tried: https://bankable.africa/en/news/2511-550-dr-congo-otojuste-starts-issuing-biometric-driving-licenses (read)
attempts.result: Bankable (25 November 2024) quotes the joint order of the Ministers of Transport and Finance of 2 August 2023 setting $71.5 for category B, but gives no age and no term, so a licence (whose age the form needs) can't be written from it.

attempts.tried: bash bin/wb.sh https://www.leganet.cd/
attempts.result: A snapshot of 2026-07-01 exists (not readable here).

attempts.tried: https://www.dgrad.cd/ (the revenue authority that collects the fee), https://www.cnpr.cd/ (road safety commission)
attempts.result: Neither answered.

attempts.tried: https://web.archive.org/web/20241118033839/https://www.leganet.cd/Legislation/DroitPenal/Roulage/Loi.078.022.30.08.1978.pdf (the Code de la route, Law 78-022, read in the archive, saved dl/w16l1/wa-cd-code.pdf)
attempts.result: The 1978 code's text (two-column scan) says the licence "a une durée de validité de 5 ans" and mentions eighteen years for foreign licences; it predates the biometric licence of the 2 August 2023 order, so whether its term and age still hold wasn't settled, and no current text was found.

attempts.tried: permis de conduire biométrique RDC catégorie B âge minimum validité arrêté ministère des transports, limited to transports.gouv.cd, primature.gouv.cd, acp.cd, radiookapi.net, journalofficiel.cd, leganet.cd, presidence.cd
attempts.result: Radio Okapi and ACP on the biometric licence; snippets say the Ministry's 2025 communiqués ask for 18; the 2012 interministerial order 107/CA (35,000 FC, old). No reachable ministry page.

attempts.tried: https://www.radiookapi.net/2023/11/02/emissions/okapi-service/comment-obtenir-le-nouveau-permis-de-conduire-biometrique, https://acp.cd/economie/rdc-le-controle-des-permis-de-conduire-desormais-effectif-sur-lensemble-du-territoire/, https://www.mediacongo.net/
attempts.result: Radio Okapi answers but states no age; ACP and mediacongo answered 403.

attempts.tried: The leganet snapshot above
attempts.result: Read; not enough (see official-register).

These include types A, B, and C: ... Is is for residence purpose only and it is issued mainly to retired foreign citizens and international students. ... Is for residence and employment purposes. sources.title: Police Nationale du Mali, Direction de la Police aux Frontières, Division Titres de séjour: Portail numérique officiel des titres de séjour
sources.said: Portail numérique officiel des titres de séjour ... LOI 04-058 AN RM — Conditions d'entrée, de séjour et d'établissement des étrangers au Mali ... Tout étranger âgé de plus de 18 ans doit, à l'expiration d'un délai de trois mois, depuis son entrée sur le territoire du Mali, se faire délivrer une autorisation de séjour temporaire par l'Autorité en charge de l'immigration. L'autorisation de séjour temporaire accordée à l'étranger non immigrant, donne lieu à la délivrance d'un visa de séjour. Le visa de séjour est valable au plus pour un an, à compter de la date de sa délivrance. Il est apposé sur le passeport du titulaire. Il est renouvelable. ... L'autorisation de séjour temporaire est accordée de plein droit : ... 1. à l'étranger marié depuis au moins trois mois, avec un ressortissant de nationalité malienne ... L'autorisation de séjour accordée à l'étranger immigrant donne lieu à la délivrance d'une carte de résident. La carte de résident est valable pour cinq ans, à compter de la date de sa délivrance. Elle est renouvelable. ... L'étranger ne peut exercer aucune activité professionnelle salariée au Mali sans y avoir été autorisé conformément à la législation en vigueur. ... DÉCRET 05-322 P RM — Conditions d'établissement et de séjour des étrangers au Mali ... Toute demande d'autorisation de séjour égal ou supérieur à six mois doit être formulée, postérieurement à l'entrée au Mali, auprès de l'autorité en charge de l'immigration. ... Le visa de séjour est délivré contre paiement d'un droit de timbre conformément aux dispositions du Code général des impôts. Le renouvellement du visa de séjour donne lieu au versement du même droit de timbre. ... L'étranger désireux de s'établir au Mali, pour y exercer une activité salariée, doit, en plus des pièces énumérées à l'article 23 ci-dessus, produire un contrat de travail revêtu du visa de la Direction nationale du travail.

sources.said: Article 2 : Le numéro d’identification unique est attribué par la direction générale des impôts et des domaines, sur la base des renseignements fournis par le contribuable. ... prend seize caractères dont : ... un caractère déterminant le type de personne ... deux caractères prenant en compte les deux derniers de l’année de création; ... douze caractères représentant la séquence des chiffres précédée à gauche par “0“ ; ... un caractère de contrôle alpha numérique basé sur l’algorithme LUHN. ... Article 4 : Tout requérant, personne physique, pour son immatriculation, s’adresse au service des impôts du lieu de sa résidence ou de son principal établissement ... Article 7 : L’immatriculation est gratuite. ... le coût est fixé à mille cinq cents francs CFA, pour les personnes physiques

sources.title: Journal officiel de la République du Congo n° 7-2023: Arrêté n° 439 du 7 février 2023 modifiant l'arrêté n° 25604
sources.said: Arrêté n° 439 du 7 février 2023 modifiant l’arrêté n° 25604 déterminant les transactions économiques et les formalités administratives dont la réalisation est obligatoirement soumise à l’utilisation du Numéro d’Identification Unique (NIU) ... entrent en vigueur à compter du 30 juin 2023.

entries.sought: The national number Gabon gives its people: its name, issuer, format, when it's given and what needs it

sources.title: Journal officiel de la République gabonaise: Loi n° 027/2020 du 24/12/2020 relative au numéro d'identification personnel
sources.said: Article 2 : La présente loi s'applique à tous les citoyens gabonais résidant sur le territoire national ou non et aux personnes de nationalité étrangère résidant au Gabon ... Article 4 : Le Numéro d'Identification Personnel est une suite de 14 caractères alphanumériques destinés à authentifier l'identité d'un individu au moyen d'un traitement informatique exécuté au moment de son inscription dans le répertoire des citoyens ou des résidents en République Gabonaise. ... Article 7 : Le Centre National de l'Etat Civil établit le NIP et en assure la gestion et la sécurité.

sources.title: Direction générale des impôts du Gabon, Immatriculation
sources.said: L’immatriculation est l’opération qui consiste à attribuer un Numéro d’Identification Fiscale unique et personnel

sources.title: Gabonreview, 'CNIE : 3 avril 2024, le Gabon embarque dans l'ère de l'identité numérique avec le NIP'
sources.said: l’enregistrement débutera le 3 avril 2024, par les citoyens gabonais âgés de 16 ans et plus qui n’ont jamais été soumis à un prélèvement biométrique dans le cadre du projet Iboga

entries.sought: The national number Samoa gives its people: its name, issuer, format, when it's given and what needs it

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Samoa: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: TINs are governed by sections 12 – 14 of the Tax Administration Act 2012. ... The TIN is issued upon approval of the business license application. ... It is not automatically issued to any or all tax residents. ... There is currently no specific or unique structure for the digits allocated for each TIN. ... Issuance of TIN started from the number 70004, there is also no specific reason for why it started from this number. ... If by today the TINs issued has come up to the number 11001, the next person who will register for a TIN will receive the TIN number of 11002.

sources.title: Kiwibank, Where to find your account number
sources.said: The first two digits tell you the bank – Kiwibank is 38. ... The next four digits tell you the branch – for Kiwibank this ranges anywhere between 9000-9499. ... it'll be 'Wellington', no matter where you opened your account. ... The next seven digits tell you the account number. ... The last two digits tell you the account suffix

entries.sought: Whether Western Australia's driving licence (AU.08) is the one held on the Cocos (Keeling) Islands (wave 9's report said the islands use WA's licences), or else the islands' own licence: the age it is held from, its fee and its term.

attempts.tried: https://www.infrastructure.gov.au/sites/default/files/documents/iot-sda-transport-services-english_0.pdf (Department of Infrastructure, 'Transport services delivered by the Department of Transport in the Indian Ocean Territories', April 2022; saved as dl/w14t3/iot-sda-transport.pdf); https://transport.wa.gov.au/licensing/visiting-moving-from-interstate.asp (redirected to /licensing/drivers-licence/visit-move-wa/moving-interstate, saved as dl/w14t3/wa-interstate.html, page updated 13 February 2026); https://www.shire.cc/ and https://shire.cc/en/services/motor-vehicle-registry.html (the Shire of Cocos (Keeling) Islands' motor vehicle registry page)
attempts.result: The SDA sheet: WA's Department of Transport, for the Australian Government, 'supports the issuing of driver's licences', aiming at consistency 'as far as practicable' with WA's system, and licences are processed by the Shire of Cocos (Keeling) Islands; it doesn't say whose licence is issued, nor its age, fee or term. sources.said: Décret n° 2006-278 du 8 mars 2006 modifiant le décret n° 82-103 du 22 janvier 1982 relatif au répertoire national d'identification des personnes physiques et portant extension à l‘Outre-mer de l'identification au répertoire ... Le NIR (numéro d'inscription au répertoire) est un identifiant unique des personnes inscrites au répertoire national d'identification des personnes physiques (RNIPP) géré par l'INSEE. ... il est composé de 15 chiffres ... En Polynésie française, il servira aux personnes évasanées pour leur traitement médical en Métropole et à certains retraités locaux, ainsi qu'aux étudiants polynésiens ... attempts.result: Read: Ley 5016 art. 22(g) fixes 18 for the 'Particular' category nationally ('Dieciocho años para la licencia de conducir de categorías "Particular", "Motociclista" y "Extranjero"'); art. 24(a) has the municipalities issue it, (b) on a unified model whose standards the ANTSV approves, and (c) 'Las licencias podrán otorgarse por una validez de hasta 5 (cinco) años'. The regulation, Decreto 3427/2015 Annex art. 7(c): 'Serán otorgadas por el plazo máximo de cinco (5) años, y en ningún caso podrá ser menor a un (1) año. Quedará a cargo de la Autoridad de aplicación determinar el tiempo de validez de cada Licencia de Conducir.' So the term is not fixed nationally (one to five years, set licence by licence), and neither text sets a fee. Ley 5799, which would have amended arts. 22 and 27, was objected in total by the Executive (message 671, 05/10/2017) and its bills are archived; no enacted amendment of art. 24 was found among the law's related bills. bacn.gov.py answered Cloudflare's 'error code: 523' (origin unreachable) on every page; gacetaoficial.gov.py reset the connection (https) and answered 503 (http).

entries.sought: The Solomon Islands' hours of sunshine as normals, which the WMO's sets, the Deutscher Wetterdienst's and the World Weather Information Service don't give

value.note: The Solomon Islands' sunshine at Henderson Airport, Guadalcanal, from JICA's 2006 study for the Solomon Islands Water Authority (Supporting Report S-1, page 13, table S-1-5): mean daily hours of sunshine, each year 1986-1998 and their 'Mean' row, turned to monthly hours by the month's days (February's 28.25), as R-0057 does for Nepal. Readings for the lead, all material: (1) the table's header says 'Year: 1986 - 1996' but its rows run to 1998 and its means are of 1986-1998 (January's 13 values average 5.95, the row's 6.0), so the period written is 1986-1998; (2) the sunshine page names no source: the next page (S-1-6, rainfall) is headed 'Solomon Islands Meteorological Service', which is the likely but unstated source; (3) thirteen years is short of a normal by WMO-No. 1203's rule, which the engine applies to GHCN-Daily only; (4) it is a consultant's compilation (secondary). If the lead holds it, the attempts below stand as the blocker.

entries.sought: Vanuatu's hours of sunshine as normals, which the WMO's sets, the Deutscher Wetterdienst's and the World Weather Information Service don't give

value.note: Vanuatu's monthly hours of sunshine at Port Vila, from the Vanuatu Meteorological Services' own page 'Climate for Port Vila (Efate)' ('Your Climate when Visiting Port Vila, Efate'), on its former site www.meteo.gov.vu, read in archive.org's snapshots of 2009-09-15 and 2017-03-29 (the page's figures are the same in both; the CDX index lists eleven captures between, the last on 2017-03-29). Each month's 'Climate Averages' gives 'Average Sunshine Hours' (198 to 139, summing to 2,152 a year), with rainfall, mean maximum and minimum temperature and humidity, all whole numbers. The current site (vmgd.gov.vu) carries no such table; a later text was looked for there (R-0105's attempts of 2026-10-26 and 2026-10-30) and in today's searches, and none was found. Only sun is taken: Port Vila's temperatures already come from the WWIS (wwis:673), and the sought days of at least 1 mm are not on the page. Readings for the lead, all material: (1) the page states no period, so period is null (the form allows it; the lead's rule asks for a stated period); (2) 'Average Sunshine Hours' is read as the month's total hours (the values, 139 to 208, fit monthly totals of about 4.6 to 6.7 hours a day, not daily means); (3) the page names Port Vila, not a station: the place written is the WWIS's for Port Vila (-17.73, 168.32, Vanuatu's own submission), which is the same city's station, and no height is given; (4) the source is an archived copy of a page the service no longer serves (2017 at the latest). Still blocked for VU: days of at least 1 mm (attempts below).

sources.note: The Central Bank of Iraq's table of the official holidays for 2027 (saved at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-SLATE/c8b0b159-b4a5-540a-bbd6-18661cbe240c/scratchpad/dl/w16h/cbi-78.html). Days marked * are approximate (the lunar ones). Its named lunar days for 2027 fall on the Umm al-Qura calendar's: Eid al-Fitr 1 to 3 Shawwal (9 to 11 March), Eid al-Adha from 10 Dhu al-Hijja for four days (16 to 19 May), al-Ghadir 18 Dhu al-Hijja (24 May), the Hijri New Year 1 Muharram (6 June), Ashura 10 Muharram (15 June), the Mawlid 12 Rabi al-Awwal (14 August). The two days it calls only 'a religious occasion' (4 January and 24 July) are kept as the dates it gives, not as a lunar rule. It names no law, no rule for a holiday on the weekend, and no Kurdistan Region days; the Official Holidays Law No. 12 of 2024's text and the 2026 days the Council of Ministers set were not read.

sources.said: 1. Public holidays The days stated in the Schedule shall be public holidays. 2. President may declare other public holidays The President acting on the advice of the Prime Minister may from time to time declare other days as public holidays. 3. Public holidays falling on Sundays When any of the days stated is a Sunday the following Monday shall be a public holiday and when Family Day falls upon a Monday the day following shall be a public holiday. ... SCHEDULE (Section 1) New Year's Day Lini Day (21 February) Custom Chief's Day (5 March) Good Friday Easter Monday Labour Day (1 May) Ascension Day Children’s National Day (24 July) Independence Day Assumption Day National Unity Day (5 October) Constitution Day (29 November) Christmas Day Family Day ... Schedule Amended by Acts 17 of 1993, 50 of 2005

sources.said: National Holiday 1 January New Years day / Nouvel An National Holiday 21 February In Memory of the "Fr. of Independence" Fr.Dr.W.H.Lini National Holiday 5 March Custom Chief's Day / Fete des Chefs coutumiers National Holiday 10 April Good Friday / Vendredi Saint National Holiday 13 April Easter Monday National Holiday 1 May Labour Day / Fete due Travail National Holiday 21 May Ascension Provincial Holiday 18 June Shefa Day National Holiday 24 July Children's Day / Journee Mondiale des Enfants National Holiday 30 July Independence day /Jour de independence National Holiday 15 August Assumption day / Fete de l'assomption Provincial Holiday 16 September Penama Day Provincial Holiday 24 September Sanma Day Provincial Holiday 2 October Torba Day National Holiday 5 October Constitution day / Fete de la Constitution Provincial Holiday 8 October Tafea Day Provincial Holiday 10 October Malampa Day National Holiday 29 November Unity Day / Fete de l'Unite National Holiday 25 December Christmas Day / Fete de Noel National Holiday 26 December Family day / Fete de Famille
sources.note: Saved at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-SLATE/c8b0b159-b4a5-540a-bbd6-18661cbe240c/scratchpad/dl/w16h2/vu-holidays.html. The live page answered with the same table on 2026-10-30. Its movable days are 2020's (Good Friday 10 April, Ascension 21 May), so the table is read for its fixed days and the provincial days only. The Act gives the national days and the Sunday rule; the Government's page gives the same days and each province's own. Readings: the Act's Schedule pairs 5 October with National Unity Day and 29 November with Constitution Day, the Government's page the other way round; the names here are the page's, the dates the same either way. The provincial days are kept only in their province (Shefa VU.18, Penama VU.17, Sanma VU.13, Torba VU.07, Tafea VU.15, Malampa VU.16) and, being outside the Act's Schedule, aren't moved off a Sunday; neither source says by what act they are held. Section 3's Sunday rule is kept as the next day that isn't already a holiday, which gives its Family Day case (Christmas on a Sunday: Monday and Tuesday). Days the President declares under section 2 (none for 2026 read) aren't kept. The lists are the rules' days for 2026.

sources.title: Direção Geral de Turismo e Hotelaria de São Tomé e Príncipe (Visit São Tomé e Príncipe), Feriados, as archive.org's snapshot of 16 June 2026 holds it
sources.said: São Tomé e Príncipe celebram dezasseis feriados nacionais todos os anos. Estes feriados são regulamentados pela Constituição de São Tomé e Príncipe eno Diário da República, Nº56-29 de Dezembro de 2025. ... Os feriados que ocorrem num fim-de-semana são comemorados nos dias de semana, por exemplo, se um feriado calhar no domingo, comemora-se na segunda-feira. O governo de São Tomé e Príncipe reserva-se o direito de declarar um único feriado pago, se a ocasião surgir. ... 1 de JANEIRO - Ano Novo ... 4 JANEIRO - Dia do Rei Amador ... 17 JANEIRO - Descoberta da Ilha do Príncipe ... 3 FEVEREIRO - Dia dos Mártires da Liberdade ... 29 ABRIL - Autonomia da ilha do Príncipe ... 1 MAIO - Dia do Trabalhador ... 1 de JUNHO - Dia Mundial da Crianças ... 12 JULHO - Dia da Independência de São Tomé e Príncipe ... 15 AGOSTO - Festa de São Lourenço ou festa de SANTO ANTÓNIO PRÍNCIPE ... 6 SETEMBRO - Dia das Forças Armadas ... 30 SETEMBRO - Dia da Reforma Agrícola ... 2 de NOVEMBRO- Dia dos Finados ... 26 de NOVEMBRO- Dia da Assinatura do acordo de Argel ... 21 DEZEMBRO - Dia de São Tomé e do Governo de Transição ... 25 DEZEMBRO - Dia de Natal ou da família ... DIA DE CINZAS- Feriado móvel ( Dia do Bocado) A Quarta-feira de Cinzas é um feriado móvel do calendário cristão, cuja data varia todos os anos, sendo celebrada após o Carnaval.
sources.note: The Government's tourism directorate's page (its 'Institucional' page, snapshot of the same day, saved at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-SLATE/c8b0b159-b4a5-540a-bbd6-18661cbe240c/scratchpad/dl/w16h2/st-inst.html, names the Direção Geral de Turismo e Hotelaria), saved at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-SLATE/c8b0b159-b4a5-540a-bbd6-18661cbe240c/scratchpad/dl/w16h2/st-feriados.html from the snapshot's raw form; the live host doesn't answer. It rests on the Diário da República n.º 56 of 29 December 2025 (Lei n.º 8/2025), whose text wasn't found online; STP-Press (2026-10-27) quoted the law's article 2 for Ash Wednesday, a movable holiday, and the Family Day, which agrees. Its sixteen days are kept nationwide, as it calls them all national, the three Príncipe days among them. Readings: its weekend sentence gives only Sunday's rule (the Monday), so a Sunday holiday is kept on the next day that isn't one and a Saturday one isn't moved; the law's own wording wasn't read. Ash Wednesday is Easter less 46 days. A day the Government declares (none for 2026 read) isn't kept. The lists are these rules' days for 2026 and 2027.

entries.sought: Cook Islands's public holidays, the days off its law or its government's list names, nationally and in each first-level region that keeps its own

sources.title: PacLII, Cook Islands Sessional Legislation, Public Holidays Act 1999 (No. 17), as archive.org's snapshot of 29 January 2025 holds it
sources.said: "Anzac Day" shall mean the 25th day of April in each year; "Constitution Day" shall mean the 4th day of August in each year; "Cook Islands Gospel Day" shall mean the 26th day of October in each year; "The Sovereign's Birthday" shall be the same date as the reigning Sovereign's birthday is observed in New Zealand; "Christmas Day" shall mean the 25th day of December in each year; "Boxing Day" shall mean the 26th day of December in each year; "New Year's day" shall mean the 1st day of January in each year; "The Day Following New Year's day" shall mean the 2nd day of January in each year; "Good Friday" shall be the same date in each year as Good Friday is observed in New Zealand; "Easter Monday" shall be the same date in each year as Easter Monday is observed in New Zealand. ... (2) Where a public holiday (other than a Sunday and ANZAC Day) falls on a Saturday or a Sunday, the holiday shall be observed on the following Monday. If both Christmas Day, Boxing Day, New Year's day and the Day Following New Year's Day fall on a Saturday and a Sunday, then those public holidays shall be observed respectively on the next Monday and Tuesday. ... (4) If an Island Gospel day falls on a Saturday or a Sunday, Island Gospel day on that island shall be observed on the following Monday. ... FIRST SCHEDULE Every Sunday Good Friday Easter Monday Anzac Day The Sovereign's Birthday Constitution Day Cook Islands Gospel Day Christmas Day Boxing Day New Year's day The day following New Year's Day SECOND SCHEDULE Public Holidays (Aitutaki Gospel Day) Order 1989 Public Holidays (Penrhyn Gospel Day) Order 1989 Public Holidays (Pukapuka Gospel Day) Order 1992 Public Holidays (Rakahanga Gospel Day) Order 1992 Public Holidays (Rarotonga Gospel Day) Order 1991
sources.note: Saved at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-SLATE/c8b0b159-b4a5-540a-bbd6-18661cbe240c/scratchpad/dl/w16h2/ck-pha1999.html from the snapshot's raw form; PacLII itself answers with a Cloudflare challenge (not passed).

sources.title: PacLII, Cook Islands Sessional Legislation, Public Holidays (Ra o te Ui Ariki) Amendment Act 2013 (No. 4), as archive.org's snapshot of 29 January 2025 holds it
sources.said: This Act amends the Public Holidays Act 1999. Interpretation Section 2 of the principal Act is amended by deleting the definition of Ra o te Ui Ariki and substituting the following- " Ra o te Ui Ariki means the first Friday of July in each calendar year".
sources.note: Saved at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-SLATE/c8b0b159-b4a5-540a-bbd6-18661cbe240c/scratchpad/dl/w16h2/ck-uiariki2013.html. The Act it amends had a definition of Ra o te Ui Ariki, so an amendment between 1999 and 2013 (not found) made the day; reading: it is a public holiday of the First Schedule as amended. Further readings: the Sovereign's Birthday is New Zealand's (the first Monday in June, as the game's New Zealand rules keep it, from the Holidays Act 2003); Anzac Day isn't moved off a weekend (2026's falls on a Saturday and stays there); any other day on a Saturday or Sunday is kept on the next day that isn't a holiday, which gives the Act's Monday and Tuesday for Christmas and Boxing Day, and New Year's two days. Not kept: each island's Gospel Day (the Second Schedule's Orders in Executive Council for Aitutaki, Penrhyn, Pukapuka, Rakahanga and Rarotonga, and any later ones, weren't read, so their days aren't known), and any amendment after 2013 (PacLII's sessional lists for 2014 to 2026 weren't read year by year). The Parliament's Gazette index for 2026 (read 2026-10-30) holds no holiday notice; its No. 13 gives employees time off to vote, not a holiday. The lists are these rules' days for 2026 and 2027.

entries.sought: Micronesia's public holidays, the days off its law or its government's list names, nationally and in each first-level region that keeps its own

sources.title: Congress of the Federated States of Micronesia, Public Law No. 21-209 (Congressional Bill No. 21-146, C.D.1), approved 24 November 2020
sources.said: The following days shall be observed as national holidays throughout the Federated States of Micronesia: (1) the first day of January of each year, which is hereby designated as New Year’s Day; (2) the tenth day of May of each year, which is hereby designated as Federated States of Micronesia Day ... (3) the third day of November of each year, which is hereby designated as Independence Day ... (4) the eleventh day of November of each year, which is hereby designated as Veterans Day ... (5) the twenty-fifth day of December of each year, which is hereby designated as Christmas Day; (6) the twenty-fourth day of October of each year, which is hereby designated as United Nations Day; (7) the thirty-first day of March of each year, which is hereby designated as Micronesian Culture and Tradition Day; and (8) ... the twenty-third day of November of each year, President Tosiwo Nakayama’s birthday, which is hereby designated as Presidents Day.
sources.note: Saved at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-SLATE/c8b0b159-b4a5-540a-bbd6-18661cbe240c/scratchpad/dl/w16h2/fm-pl21-209.pdf. It rewrites 1 F.S.M.C. § 601 whole. The Congress's lists of the 22nd, 23rd and 24th Congresses' public laws (cfsm.gov.fm/22nd-public-laws/, /23rd-cfsm-public-laws/, /24th-public-laws/, read 2026-10-31, saved at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-SLATE/c8b0b159-b4a5-540a-bbd6-18661cbe240c/scratchpad/dl/w16h2/cfsm-22nd.html and the like) name no later law on holidays or title 1.

sources.title: FSM Supreme Court Law Library (fsmlaw.org), Code of the Federated States of Micronesia, Title 1, Chapter 6: Holidays, as archive.org's snapshot of 13 May 2026 holds it
sources.said: § 602. Conditions of observance. All holidays set forth in section 601 of this chapter shall, if they occur on a Saturday, be observed on the preceding Friday, and shall, if they occur on a Sunday, be observed on the following Monday. Source : PL 1-28 § 1; PL 4-86 § 2. § 603. Other holidays. No holidays other than those set forth in section 601 of this chapter shall be observed by any employee or official of the National Government of the Federated States of Micronesia .
sources.note: Saved at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-SLATE/c8b0b159-b4a5-540a-bbd6-18661cbe240c/scratchpad/dl/w16h2/fm-t01ch06.html from the snapshot's raw form; fsmlaw.org itself answers 406 to this client. Its § 601 is an older text (five days); § 602 is read from it, which P.L. 21-209 didn't touch. Readings: a Saturday holiday is kept on the Friday before and a Sunday one on the Monday after (2026: 10 May on Monday 11 May, 24 October on Friday 23 October). Not kept: each state's own holidays (Kosrae, Pohnpei, Chuuk and Yap, under their state codes, not read), so a state's days are missing. The lists are these rules' days for 2026 and 2027.

Final voting for the Directing award shall be restricted to active and life Academy members. ... in one of the six qualifying U.S. metro areas ... for a theatrical qualifying run of at least seven consecutive days in the same commercial motion picture theater ... must begin between January 1, 2026, and December 31, 2026.

sources.title: Sundance Institute, 2027 Development Track FAQ
sources.said: The Screenwriters Lab is for first- or second-time fiction feature writers, writer-directors, or writer-director teams. ... The Screenwriters Intensive is for first-time fiction feature writers or writer-directors, with priority given to artists from traditionally underrepresented communities. ... There is no open application process for the Directors Lab, which is typically populated by projects that have already been supported via a prior Institute program, such as a Screenwriters Lab, Intensive, or grant. ... Applications for the 2027 Screenwriters Lab and Screenwriters Intensive will be available online from April 14, 2026, through May 12, 2026 ... Approximately 1,000 to 1,200 complete screenplays are considered as part of the second round. ... Aside from an application fee, we do not charge for participation in our programs.

sources.said: SDC is a national labor union and at this time covers stage work in the United States only. ... To join as a Full Member , initiation is currently $2,400 and Annual Dues are currently $240. ... To join as an Associate Member , initiation is currently $375 and Annual Dues are currently $90.

sources.title: California Senate Judiciary Committee, analysis of SB 764 (hearing January 11, 2024), "Existing law" on Family Code 6750-6753
sources.said: Regulates the following contracts entered into between an unemancipated minor and a third party: ... writer, director, producer, production executive, choreographer, ... Requires the court, in an order approving the above contracts, to require that 15 percent of the minor’s gross earnings pursuant to the contract be set aside by the minor’s employer ... blocked from use until the minor is emancipated or reaches age 18. ... (Fam. Code § 6750.) ... (Fam. Code § 6752.)
